_projectHeader.Note: Project metadata only; original source credits and license notices are retained.

env.notes: Optional custom-command API credentials. Set INSTABOT_TOKEN / INSTABOT_URL as environment variables when needed.

account.notes: Instagram login is cookie-only. Put your Instagram cookies in account.txt: a Netscape cookie file (Cookie-Editor export), a `sessionid=...; ds_user_id=...; csrftoken=...` string, or a JSON array of cookie objects. `sessionid` and `ds_user_id` are required. `proxy` is an optional HTTP(S) proxy URL and `userAgent` overrides the default Instagram Android user agent.

music.notes: Song search for the sing command. Leave apiUrl/apiToken blank to search Instagram's own music catalogue. Point them at your music server to search there instead; {query} is replaced with the song text.

welcome.selfMessage:
Thanks for adding me to %2 group.
 Type {prefix}help to see all available commands.
welcome.notes: Greet members added to a group thread. %1 = the new member, %2 = the thread name. selfMessage is sent when the BOT itself is added ({prefix} = the live prefix, %2 = the group name). Leave threadIDs empty for every thread, or list the thread IDs to limit it.

leave.message: %1 He/She is no more this group..
leave.notes: Announce members who leave or are removed from a group thread. %1 = the member, %2 = the thread name. Leave threadIDs empty for every thread.

onlineStatus.notes: Appends one JSON line per interval recording that the bot is online, together with uptime and basic stats.

database.notes: Simple JSON storage for users and threads. Files are created automatically.
